statusVocabulary.declared: Publicly declared by the publisher; on-chain resolution must be checked independently.
statusVocabulary.proposed: Semantically reserved in the architecture but not represented as active.
statusVocabulary.owner-signature-required: Publication is ready; ENS activation requires an owner-signed mainnet transaction.
statusVocabulary.active: Activated with published transaction evidence and independently resolvable records.
statusVocabulary.superseded: Replaced while retained in the Chronicle.
statusVocabulary.revoked: Explicitly revoked with a public reason and Chronicle reference.

entries.title: Addressable Root of Machine Civilizations
entries.notes: Discovery and identity only. Root control does not confer proof, admission or operational authority.

entries.title: SUCCESSOR Ω
entries.notes: Institutional identity declared. Operational admission requires fresh public proof and a bounded authority record.

entries.title: Append-only Institutional Chronicle
entries.controlRequirement: Independent from the current successor's unilateral control.

entries.title: Proof Requests and Results
entries.controlRequirement: The claimant must not control decisive evidence and final verification.

entries.title: Independent Verifier Discovery
entries.controlRequirement: Separate incentives, control and evidence access proportional to value at risk.

entries.title: Successor Qualification and Authority State
entries.controlRequirement: Admission must reference a frozen candidate, proof result, scope, expiry and rollback path.

entries.title: Bounded Resources and Settlement
entries.controlRequirement: Limits, timelocks, separation of duties and public risk disclosures.
